name: Tengshe
introduce:
DD-720 螣蛇
由多尔集团参与研发的轻型机兵。
螣蛇在外观设计和装甲选材上进行了较为激进的革新，在保证常规防护性的同时，大大减轻了机身重量。其搭配的常规动力系统，以及优化能效的「光焰核心」，使得螣蛇能在保持高速机动的同时，装载更大更重的大规模杀伤性武器。总的来说，螣蛇的诞生对传统轻型机兵的战场定位进行了彻底颠覆。

30388.name: Servo Mod
30388.SpecificEffects: In combat, if own HP percentage is greater or equal to the target, DMG dealt is increased by <color=#F74848>18%</color>. If this attack is not an active attack, DMG dealt is increased by additionally <color=#F74848>12%</color>. When actively attacking, if <color=#F74848>5</color> AP or more is consumed, restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat. Can trigger at maximum <color=#F74848>1</color> times per turn.

20464.name: Flame Core Mod
20464.SpecificEffects: When attacking with skills of <color=#F74848>3</color> AP or more, DMG increased by <color=#F74848>20%</color>. For every <color=#F74848>1</color> additional AP consumed, the effect increases by <color=#F74848>5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>35%</color>.
